summary: The Western Plaguelands are where the plague was first let into Lordaeron, and they are also the half that has largely been taken back: the Cenarion Circle lifted most of the blight during the Cataclysm, and crops grow again on farms that used to be cauldron sites. The Argent Crusade runs its Lordaeron operation out of Hearthglen and trains recruits there, while Andorhal, fought over by Alliance and Forsaken death knights, ended up in Forsaken hands. Caer Darrow out in Darrowmere Lake is the largest thing the Scourge still holds, with Scholomance beneath it.
history: This was forest and farmland, Hearthglen the seat of the local administration and Andorhal the point every sack of northern Lordaeron's grain passed through — which is exactly why it was chosen. Kel'Thuzad's cultists infected the grain and hid plague cauldrons on four of the largest farms, and the countryside died and stood back up. The Scarlet Crusade held Mardenholde Keep at Hearthglen for years afterwards. Agents of the Argent Dawn eventually turned the cauldrons' contents against the Scourge, Tirion Fordring reclaimed his own town for the Argent Crusade, and the Cenarion Circle undid most of the corruption. The Battle for Andorhal between Thassarian and Sylvanas's forces settled who keeps the ruins.
factions: Scourge and the Cult of the Damned
